items.title: Talkin' TCGS
items.description:
Talkin' TCGS: The original podcast talking about The Chris Gethard Show hosted by Riley Soloner and Griffin Newman.
Covers the post-Comedy Central Pilot Era of the MNN run.
 
Boasts deep interviews with key cast and crew, exclusives and scoops!

items.title: TCGS After Party Podcast
items.description:
The successor to Talkin' TCGS, The TCGS After Party Podcast ran during the first season of TCGS on Fusion, but retained Riley and Griffin as hosts. 

It did not return for a second season.

At the moment these are slightly compressed versions.
